name: iac-infra
description: Infraestructura del Asistente IA — Terraform con LocalStack y AWS

scripts.infra:plan:local: terraform -chdir=infra workspace select -or-create local && terraform -chdir=infra plan -var-file=providers-local.tfvars
scripts.infra:apply:local: terraform -chdir=infra workspace select -or-create local && terraform -chdir=infra apply -auto-approve -var-file=providers-local.tfvars
scripts.infra:destroy:local: terraform -chdir=infra workspace select -or-create local && terraform -chdir=infra destroy -auto-approve -var-file=providers-local.tfvars
scripts.infra:plan:aws: terraform -chdir=infra workspace select -or-create aws && terraform -chdir=infra plan -var-file=providers-aws.tfvars
scripts.infra:apply:aws: terraform -chdir=infra workspace select -or-create aws && terraform -chdir=infra apply -var-file=providers-aws.tfvars
scripts.infra:destroy:aws: terraform -chdir=infra workspace select -or-create aws && terraform -chdir=infra destroy -var-file=providers-aws.tfvars
scripts.infra:output:local: terraform -chdir=infra workspace select -or-create local && terraform -chdir=infra output
scripts.infra:output:aws: terraform -chdir=infra workspace select -or-create aws && terraform -chdir=infra output
